question: Does a user receive useful, supported recurring analysis with less ongoing work when their capable BI agent also has SignalWeave?
primary_treatment: Luna xhigh with the published default-profile MCP, bundled SignalWeave skill and live Jev for narrow saved-policy decisions
control: The same Luna model, company BI tools, source definitions, business owners, local inboxes, persistent notes, SQL and deterministic automation capabilities, without SignalWeave
claim_unit: A company workflow trajectory, not each dependent source date or API call

methodological_sources.application: Inspect retained traces and actual final environment/messages; software-test success and actor self-reports do not establish the desired outcome
Evaluate interaction with simulated company users, tools and policy; keep repeated-trial reliability distinct from one successful trajectory

stages.scope: Fresh setup, agent-authored SQL and reviewed card, seven finalized historical fulfillment periods, useful weekly messages and investigations
stages.owner: Explicitly scripted business owner, not a model or real human
stages.connector: Actual local Superset and community Superset MCP; same 27 analytical source tools per arm
stages.time_boundary: Retrospective finalized warehouse, not an as-known-at-the-time backtest
stages.disposition: Closed v1 diagnostic: both agents completed, but the research proxy exhausted its nine-call cap and injected three HTTP 429s. Original records remain unchanged at source revision a131be1.
stages.claim_limit: Known-company diagnostic with research-resource interference, not a clean native reliability or efficiency comparison

stages.scope: New fresh paired onboarding and seven-period execution, treatment first; no previous cards, SQL, notes or business outputs copied
stages.budget_basis: The previous execution required token-budgeted watch and outcome request batches, not one provider call per check. Reserve up to eight batches per period plus eight setup/recovery calls. This finite ceiling does not require those calls to be spent.
stages.resource_audit: Count research-proxy rejections separately from actual upstream failures. Any rejection contaminates native reliability/efficiency interpretation regardless of correct final messages.
stages.claim_limit: Adaptive method repair on known historical data; not a holdout, statistical power claim or causal estimate of the budget change

stages.scope: Separate queue and weekly onboarding, agent-authored source queries and cards, daily checks, Monday briefs, owner policy change, feedback and final handoff
stages.owner: Five model-simulated company roles with bounded knowledge and recorded clarification/consent, not actual humans
stages.connector: Actual read-only company MCP over isolated source SQLite snapshots, not a vendor-cloud connector
stages.time_boundary: Only events available by each source cutoff are visible to either arm
stages.native_profile: Normal agent profile plus six explicitly enabled optional domain-context tools; 17 tools verified in preflight
stages.claim_limit: Known development history; every existing daily state has qualifying work, so this cohort cannot establish quiet-day suppression or false-alert precision

stages.scope: Freeze independently seeded raw histories and owner policies before either agent sees them; include quiet, onset, recovery, delayed/corrected data, optional versus required missing evidence and definition ambiguity
requirements: Materially different source populations and business meaning, not renamed metrics or chart copies
Counterbalanced arm order and repeated fresh onboarding before claiming repeatability
Independent raw-source arithmetic and arm-blinded human-message review
Preflight source availability, tooling parity, ordinary owner consent and resource capacity
A separately reviewed protocol and finite inference budget before spending

primary_outcomes: Supported, useful first answer and correctly retained business meaning
Important issues communicated to the right intended recipient without unsupported all-clears or causes
Concision, actionable next step and accessible evidence in the actual delivered message
Faithful recurring policy after feedback or a definition/owner change
Total onboarding, repair, review and recurring effort, including unfinished and failed attempts
measurements: Complete and incomplete trajectories with explicit denominators
Actual local deliveries, redundant messages, missed requested handoffs and recipient attachment reads separately
Independently recomputed quantities, populations, periods and coverage
Frontier input, cached input, uncached input, output, provider calls and known provider usage
Wall time with concurrent workload and source/cache conditions disclosed; no total-dollar claim when billing is unknown
Card/source versions, approval evidence, receipt reuse and live-inference identities
execution_rules: Zero-inference setup and source/transport preflight precede paid agents; failures remain in a separate attempt ledger
Independent admission binds the exact study and passing preflight hashes
No researcher supplies or repairs the analytical SQL, card, baseline helper or final message
Both agents may correct their own ordinary tool errors and ask their company experts
A timeout is an incomplete attempt; retain unknown usage as unknown, never zero, and do not silently retry into success
Do not start the next paid stage with unknown prior usage or above its frozen budget ceiling
Readiness for recurrence requires review of the actual reusable procedure and policy branches, not a single positive readout
Quiet exception checks may skip frontier work; routine requested digests still require a useful message in both arms
Keep source correctness, native judgments, agent outcomes and simulated recipient usefulness separate
No source facts, scored labels or future snapshots are exposed to actors
Simulated inboxes are not Slack; simulated owners are not real-human usability participants
Keep all original failure and negative-result records during archival cleanup
